summary: RB Global filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of Big Iron Auction Company. No financial terms (price, premium, shares) were disclosed. The deal, announced as finalized on May 18, 2026, expands RB Global's U.S. agriculture market presence. The board recommended the transaction, and no advisors were named. Mechanically, it is a closed acquisition; no regulatory clock or conditions remain. As a completed deal, there is no risk-arb angle; watch for integration updates and future financial contributions from BigIron.
